instruction: Enable auto save on focus change in VS Code settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code settings to enable auto-save on focus change. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify that settings.json contains 'files.autoSave': 'onFocusChange'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts VS Code settings.json from the expected path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json) - file.py:74-143

Metric (check_json_settings) correctly handles type='rule': receives rules dict directly via get_rule (misc.py:88-92), accesses expected['expected'] to get {'files.autoSave': 'onFocusChange'} - vscode.py:67
Metric logic correctly verifies JSON contains expected key-value pairs using strict comparison with sentinel pattern for None values - vscode.py:70-75

Expected value is semantically correct: 'onFocusChange' is the valid VS Code setting for auto-save on focus change per official docs (https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_save-auto-save)
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable auto-save on focus change) and evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Data flow is correct: VM file → get_vm_file → local cache → check_json_settings → JSON parse → key-value verification

Proper error handling: returns 0.0 for missing files (vscode.py:58-59), invalid JSON (vscode.py:64-65), or missing/mismatched keys (vscode.py:74-75); get_vm_file returns None for missing files (file.py:112-114)
No postconfig needed: file-based verification does not depend on UI state; settings.json persists regardless of whether VS Code UI is open (static warning is false positive)
